fact: ITWeb Africa reports that the regulator INCM validated the Internet Para Todas e Todos (Internet for All) national strategy, a roadmap to 95% broadband coverage by 2030 (period 2026 to 2030), presented in Maputo on 2026-10-08, without stating adoption by the government or a minister.
system: Internet Para Todas e Todos national strategy

fact: The Bureau de Conteudo Local, republishing Noticiaslusofonas, reports that INCM is presenting and validating a proposed National Strategy Internet para Todos with government, operators and partners, setting targets to 2030; the date of the session is not stated, so the publication date 2026-10-08 is used.

Lusa via Club of Mozambique reports that a proposed Internet for All strategy, implemented by INCM with targets through 2030, was presented in Maputo; the presentation date is not given, so the publication date 2026-10-07 is used.

Wearetech.africa reports that the Internet Para Todos programme, launched in March 2025, targets 80% mobile penetration, 95% territorial coverage and 99% network availability by 2030, a period that had not ended.

The U.S. International Trade Administration reports that in December 2024 the government launched the Internet for All project, aiming to raise internet access from under 25% to 100% of the population by 2030, with a period running to 2030.
